title: ClaimLens Ground Truth
description: The correct-answer key for one synthetic claim fixture. The extraction pipeline's OUTPUT should structurally match everything up to and including supporting_documents. resolution_expectation and known_issues exist only for eval scoring and are never shown to the extraction model.

claim_id.description: Matches the PDF filename stem, e.g. auto_c001

claim_type.description: Null only if the form itself never states a type clearly enough to classify — rare, reserved for adversarial cases

incident_date.description: ISO 8601 date, or null if not stated / illegible

date_reported.description: ISO 8601 date, or null if not stated

line_items.description: Null if the form gives no itemized breakdown at all

claimed_amount_stated.description: The total exactly as written on the form — extract this verbatim, do not correct it

claimed_amount_computed.description: Ground truth's own sum of line_items. Used by the arithmetic validator to check whether the model silently 'fixes' a mismatch instead of flagging it.

resolution_expectation.description: EVAL-ONLY. What a correctly-behaving triage agent should do with this case. Never part of the extraction target.

known_issues.description: EVAL-ONLY. Tags describing what makes this fixture hard. Drives the eval harness's per-issue-type scorecard breakdown.
